## Replay Recovery

```{r eval=FALSE}
replay.recovery <- multiRL::rpl_e(
  result = recovery.MLE,

  data = data,
  behrule = behrule,
  colnames = colnames,
  
  models = list(multiRL::TD, multiRL::RSTD, multiRL::Utility),
  settings = list(name = c("TD", "RSTD", "Utility")),

  omit = c("data", "funcs")
)
  
save(replay.recovery, file = "./replay.recovery.MLE.Rdata")

plot(x = replay.recovery)
```

```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
p <- plot(x = replay.recovery)

lapply(names(p$param), function(model_name) {
  
  model_list <- p$param[[model_name]]
  
  lapply(names(model_list), function(param_name) {
    
    plot_list <- model_list[[param_name]]
    
    file_path <- file.path(
      ".", paste0(model_name, "_", param_name, ".png")
    )
    
    ggplot2::ggsave(
      filename = file_path,
      plot = plot_list,
      width = 5,
      height = 5
    )
  })
})

ggplot2::ggsave(
  filename = "./Confusion_Matrix.png",
  plot = p$model$Confusion,
  width = 8,
  height = 6
)

ggplot2::ggsave(
  filename = "./Inversion_Matrix.png",
  plot = p$model$Inversion,
  width = 8,
  height = 6
)

rm(p)
```

## Replay Fitting

```{r eval=FALSE}
replay.fitting <- multiRL::rpl_e(
  result = fitting.XXX,

  data = data,
  behrule = behrule,
  colnames = colnames,
  
  models = list(multiRL::TD, multiRL::RSTD, multiRL::Utility),
  settings = list(name = c("TD", "RSTD", "Utility")),
  
  omit = c("funcs")
)

save(replay.fitting, file = "./replay.fitting.XXX.Rdata")

plot(x = replay.fitting)
```

<p align="center">
    <img src="./fig/Block_Ratio.png" alt="Block_Ratio" width="80%" style="display: inline;">
</p>

**Note**  

`rpl_e` includes a specialized argument called `omit`, which is used to remove specific slots from the returned results. Since the output is a complete `multiRL.model` (an S4 method object), it may contain data that lacks value for further analysis. Users can specify slot names in `omit` to reduce the memory footprint of the result.
